name: Nimbus Analytics — Internal Workspace
description: A fictitious B2B SaaS company's internal knowledge base. Employees see runbooks and policies; managers add compensation bands and hiring plans; execs see board and roadmap material.

role_hints.employee: onboarding, security policy, runbooks, postmortems, perf review guide
role_hints.manager: adds compensation bands, hiring plan, and compliance audits
role_hints.exec: full corpus including board deck, workforce memo, and roadmaps

empty_state_description: Choose a scenario or enter a question. Query retrieves document fragments; the decision trace explains access, versions and budget. Ask generates an answer only when a provider is configured.
